text: They buried a man alive with a bell tied to his finger.

text.text: But his wife isn't on her porch.
She's sitting in the dark with a shovel by the door, because she knows that ring.
He owed money to half the town, so he faked his death.
And the second that bell rang, she was supposed to grab the shovel, dig him up, and skipped town
Instead, she just sits there all night, listening to it ring fast, then slow,
then once every few minutes, until sunrise, when it finally stops.
You see, with him in the ground, every debt got buried right along with him,
and the house was all hers.
